dragon.title: Compilers: Principles, Techniques, and Tools
dragon.authors: Alfred V. Aho, Monica S. Lam, Ravi Sethi and Jeffrey D. Ullman

translators-and-compiler-overview.why: Language processors, the structure of a compiler and its phases.

linguistic-analysis-and-grammars.why: Grammars, derivations and ambiguity as used in compilers.

regular-expressions-and-finite-automata.read: Chapter 3: Lexical Analysis (regular expressions, finite automata)
regular-expressions-and-finite-automata.why: Specifying tokens with regular expressions and recognising them with automata.

language-structure-and-lexical-analysis.read: Chapter 3: Lexical Analysis; Chapter 7: Run-Time Environments
language-structure-and-lexical-analysis.why: The scanner's work, and storage and parameter passing at run time.

syntax-analysis.why: Left recursion, left factoring, FIRST and FOLLOW, top-down and bottom-up parsing.

semantic-analysis-and-intermediate-code.read: Chapter 5: Syntax-Directed Translation; Chapter 6: Intermediate-Code Generation
semantic-analysis-and-intermediate-code.why: Synthesized and inherited attributes, quadruples, triples and type checking.

optimization-code-generation-and-error-h.read: Chapter 8: Code Generation; Chapter 9: Machine-Independent Optimizations
optimization-code-generation-and-error-h.why: Register allocation, peephole optimization and loop optimization.
